scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
other_conditions: The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise (MSME) in the manufacturing sector
The enterprise must be run by an SC/ST entrepreneur with at least 51% contribution from SC/ST
The enterprise must be in production within Gujarat during the scheme's tenure
The exhibition or trade fair must be organized in India or outside India

International exhibitions must be approved by recognized bodies such as MSME Development Institute (MSME‑DI), India Trade Promotion Organization (ITPO), EEPC India, Federation of Indian Export Organizations (FIEO) or the state government
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance covering 70‑80% of exhibition expenses, up to ₹5,00,000 per event, with multiple participations allowed during the scheme tenure.
